name: Drawer navigation
description: Give every storefront a clear way to get around.
source:
Component(
  dsl: 1,
  id: "acme/nav-drawer",
  name: "Drawer navigation",
  kind: Kind.navigation,
  description: "Header with a hamburger button that opens a side drawer of links.",
  aiHints: "Use when the owner asks for a drawer, hamburger or slide-out menu navigation.",
  options: [
    EnumOption(name: "side", label: "Drawer side", values: [Side.left, Side.right], default: Side.left),
    BoolOption(name: "showLogo", label: "Show logo", default: true),
  ],
  variants: [
    Variant(
      id: "drawer",
      label: "Drawer",
      build: Row(
        justify: Justify.between,
        align: Align.center,
        padding: Space.md,
        children: [
          Drawer(
            side: options.side,
            trigger: TriggerButton(icon: Icons.menu, ariaLabel: "Open menu", style: ButtonStyle.ghost),
            child: Column(
              gap: Space.sm,
              padding: Space.lg,
              children: [
                ForEach(
                  items: items,
                  as: "item",
                  child: Button(
                    label: item.label,
                    icon: item.icon,
                    style: ButtonStyle.ghost,
                    fullWidth: true,
                    onTap: Navigate(to: item.route),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          If(
            condition: options.showLogo,
            then: Image(src: store.logo_url, alt: store.name, height: 32, fit: Fit.contain),
          ),
          Button(label: "Cart (${cart.count})", icon: Icons.cart, onTap: Navigate(to: Route.cart)),
        ],
      ),
    ),
  ], data: [Data(name: "store", from: Client.store(), fetch: "client", type: Store), Data(name: "cart", from: Client.cart(), fetch: "client", type: Cart)],
)
